## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
library("msigdbr")
```

## Load data

The analysis is done on the results of the differential expression analysis

```{r}
lm_results <- read_tsv("../data/processed/05_dat_lm_results.tsv.gz")


```

## DEGs and background

I create two different datasets, one containing the differential expressed genes and one containing the background

```{r}
deg_genes <- lm_results |> 
  filter(q_value < 0.05) |> 
  pull(gene) |>
  unique()

background_genes <- lm_results |>
  pull(gene) |>
  unique()

length(deg_genes)
length(background_genes)
```

The DE genes are 53, all the genes tested are 20416.

## Gene sets

```{r}
bp_df <- msigdbr(species = "human", #selects gene sets for human genes.
                 category = "C5", #selects the Gene Ontology collection.
                 subcategory = "GO:BP") #biological processes

bp_df |>
  select(ensembl_gene) |>
  head()

```

The `msigdbr` package was used to retrieve gene sets from C5 which contains gene sets from the Gene Ontology. In particular I selected the biological process subcollection, so the dataset `GO_df` contains information about the biological processes associated with each gene.

The genes in bp_df are without point so i need to change the enseble in the lm_results
